title: Human Anatomy and Embodiment
description: A reusable body coordinate system, physical-system assets, interoceptive and attentional overlays, and semantic mechanisms for embodiment, meditation, breath, regulation and body-world interaction.

assets.description: A canonical front-facing human outline anchored to a stable named landmark coordinate system.
A canonical seated meditation posture with stable head, spine, hands, pelvis and knee geometry.
Named bodily coordinates for crown, brow, throat, heart, diaphragm, navel, root, joints and extremities.
Paired lungs and a moving diaphragm that visibly expand and contract through a respiratory cycle.
A beating heart with schematic pulse routes toward the head, hands and feet.
A central neural axis with peripheral branches and propagating signal points.
A breathing operational boundary surrounding the body without implying an absolute metaphysical enclosure.
A movable field of emphasis centered on a named bodily landmark or custom coordinate.
A moving attention band that traverses the canonical body from crown to feet or in reverse.
A deterministic particle current moving vertically through or around the body coordinate field.
provenance: platinum collection: repeated luminous currents and moving particles

mechanisms.description: A stable body remains present while a field of relevance moves between bodily regions.
mechanisms.motionProof: The body remains invariant while the highlighted region changes, proving that felt location is produced by selective relevance rather than a fixed inner observer.

mechanisms.description: Attention traverses bodily regions in a visible ordered scan while the whole body remains available as context.
mechanisms.motionProof: The moving band creates an ordered sampling of stable bodily regions; a still cannot show which region was attended before or after.

mechanisms.description: Many noisy local motions progressively coordinate around a seated body without disappearing.
mechanisms.motionProof: Disordered marks reduce their jitter and coordinate into a slower shared rhythm, distinguishing regulation from blankness or annihilation.

mechanisms.description: Air direction, lung volume and diaphragm position form one reversible respiratory cycle.
mechanisms.motionProof: Air reverses direction while lung volume and diaphragm position change together, so the mechanism exists in the coordinated cycle rather than one pose.

mechanisms.description: Respiratory phase and bodily attention change together while remaining distinguishable processes.
mechanisms.motionProof: The respiratory volume and attention halo change phase together, making coupling visible without claiming that either process is identical to the other.

mechanisms.description: A local stimulus produces timed signals across central and peripheral neural routes.
mechanisms.motionProof: A signal begins at one bodily site and reaches distributed pathways at different times, visibly performing propagation rather than merely drawing nerves.

mechanisms.description: Several internal bodily signals converge into one provisional integrated body-state.
mechanisms.motionProof: Distinct organ signals travel along different paths and converge into an integrated target, showing reconstruction rather than a pre-existing complete body picture.

mechanisms.description: A bodily boundary admits, excludes and redirects environmental signals through selective channels.
mechanisms.motionProof: Moving marks encounter the same boundary and separate into admitted and rejected outcomes, proving operational selection rather than decorative enclosure.

mechanisms.description: Two initially different bodily rhythms progressively coordinate while retaining their separate traces.
mechanisms.motionProof: The two traces begin at different phase and frequency before synchronising, so the temporal approach is the evidence of entrainment.

selectionPolicy.captionPolicy: Use anatomical labels only when they disambiguate a structure; narration carries the prose.
forbiddenLiteralizations: glowing body with no encoded relation
selectionPolicy.epistemicRule: Mark physical schematics, phenomenological reports and symbolic practice-maps separately. Never imply that one category proves another.
